The well is 30 feet deep, so the snail needs to reach 27 feet by the end of a day (since 27 + 3 = 30). At a net gain of 1 foot per day, it takes 27 days to reach 27 feet. On the 28th day, the snail climbs the remaining 3 feet and escapes without sliding back. Thus, the total time is **28 days**.
